segments.text:
关于多元宇宙 你们有哪些经验
How much experience you guys have with Multiverse?

对于多元宇宙 我们最近的经验是和蜘蛛侠有关的一件事
We have the experience of the Multiverse most recently was an incident with Spider Man.

他具有蜘蛛的能力
He has the powers of a spider.

因此得名
Hence the name.

他长得像不像蜘蛛
Does he look like a spider?

不 不 更像是个人
No, no, more like a man.

能爬墙 能吐丝
Climbs walls, shoots webs.

是的 没错
Yeah. Bingo.

从屁股吐出来吗
Out his butt?

也许吧 我不知道
Maybe, I don't know.

说实话 希望不是
Honestly, I hope not.
